questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 12 Question 1: If a dielectric slab of dielectric constant K is inserted completely between the plates of an isolated charged capacitor (charge Q constant), what happens to stored energy?
options: Decreases by a factor of 1/K
Increases by a factor of K
Increases by a factor of K^2
Remains exactly invariant
questions.solution: Stored energy U = Q^2 / (2C). With dielectric, capacitance becomes C' = K*C. Since Q is constant, U' = Q^2 / (2KC) = U / K.
